name: Hemoglobin
reportDescription: Measures oxygen-carrying protein in red blood cells
interpretationGuidance: Low levels indicate anemia or blood loss; high levels may indicate polycythemia or dehydration.

name: Red Blood Cell Count
description: Total number of erythrocytes per unit volume of blood
reportDescription: Total circulating erythrocytes in peripheral whole blood
interpretationGuidance: Decreased in anemias; increased in secondary erythrocytosis or polycythemia vera.

name: Hematocrit (PCV)
description: Proportion of whole blood volume occupied by packed erythrocytes
reportDescription: Volume percentage of packed red cells in whole blood
interpretationGuidance: Decreased in anemia; increased in polycythemia and dehydration/hemoconcentration.

name: Mean Corpuscular Volume
description: Average volume of individual red blood cells
interpretationGuidance: Microcytic (<80 fL) indicates iron deficiency, thalassemia; macrocytic (>100 fL) indicates B12/folate deficiency.

name: Mean Corpuscular Hemoglobin
description: Average mass of hemoglobin per red blood cell
interpretationGuidance: Correlates directly with MCV; hypochromic red cells exhibit decreased MCH.

name: Mean Corpuscular Hemoglobin Concentration
description: Average concentration of hemoglobin in a volume of packed red blood cells
interpretationGuidance: Decreased in hypochromic anemias; increased in hereditary spherocytosis or cold agglutinins.

name: Red Cell Distribution Width (RDW-CV)
description: Measure of variation in red blood cell volume (anisocytosis)
reportDescription: Coefficient of variation of red cell volume distribution
interpretationGuidance: Elevated RDW indicates anisocytosis, useful in differentiating iron deficiency anemia from thalassemia trait.

name: Total Leukocyte Count (WBC)
description: Total number of white blood cells per unit volume of blood
reportDescription: Total circulating leukocyte concentration in peripheral blood
interpretationGuidance: Leukocytosis indicates bacterial infection, inflammation, or leukemia; leukopenia indicates marrow suppression or severe viral infection.

name: Neutrophils
description: Percentage of neutrophils in differential leukocyte count
reportDescription: Relative frequency of segmented and band neutrophils
interpretationGuidance: Neutrophilia seen in acute bacterial infection, tissue damage, or systemic inflammation.

name: Lymphocytes
description: Percentage of lymphocytes in differential leukocyte count
reportDescription: Relative frequency of lymphocytes in peripheral blood
interpretationGuidance: Lymphocytosis seen in viral infections, chronic lymphocytic leukemia, or infectious mononucleosis.

name: Monocytes
description: Percentage of monocytes in differential leukocyte count
reportDescription: Relative frequency of monocytes in peripheral blood
interpretationGuidance: Monocytosis seen in chronic intracellular infections (e.g. tuberculosis), recovery phase of infections, or autoimmune disease.

name: Eosinophils
description: Percentage of eosinophils in differential leukocyte count
reportDescription: Relative frequency of eosinophils in peripheral blood
interpretationGuidance: Eosinophilia commonly associated with allergic responses, parasitic infections, or drug hypersensitivity.

name: Basophils
description: Percentage of basophils in differential leukocyte count
reportDescription: Relative frequency of basophils in peripheral blood
interpretationGuidance: Basophilia seen in myeloproliferative disorders including chronic myeloid leukemia.

name: Platelet Count
description: Total number of thrombocytes per unit volume of blood
reportDescription: Total circulating thrombocyte concentration in peripheral blood
interpretationGuidance: Thrombocytopenia increases hemorrhagic risk; thrombocytosis seen in reactive conditions or essential thrombocythemia.

name: Mean Platelet Volume (MPV)
reportDescription: Automated thrombocyte index indicating average platelet size
interpretationGuidance: High MPV reflects increased platelet turnover with younger, larger platelets released into circulation.
